review.tagline: PDF parser that outputs Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, and Tagged PDF
review.summary: Java-based PDF parser with Python, Node.js and Java SDKs. The default local mode extracts text, tables, headings and images with bounding boxes and XY-Cut++ reading order. An optional hybrid mode runs a Docling-based backend server for OCR, complex tables, LaTeX formulas and chart descriptions. It can also auto-tag untagged PDFs into Tagged PDF; PDF/UA export is an enterprise add-on.
review.audience: Engineers feeding PDFs into RAG pipelines or automating PDF tagging
strengths: Local mode is deterministic and runs without GPU; README lists 0.015 s/page
JSON output includes bounding boxes for every element, useful for source citations
Hybrid mode adds OCR (several engines), borderless tables, LaTeX formulas and picture descriptions
Auto-tags untagged PDFs to Tagged PDF under Apache-2.0
weaknesses: Requires Java 11+ on the host in addition to Python or Node
Each convert() call spawns a JVM, so calls must be batched
PDF/UA-1/2 export and the accessibility studio are enterprise-only
Hybrid mode needs a separate backend server; no Word, Excel or PowerPoint support
needs: Needs Java 11+, Python 3.10+ (Python SDK), Docling-based hybrid backend (optional)
Models: SmolVLM 256M (picture description), EasyOCR, RapidOCR, Tesseract
